List every artifact this config fetches from outside the machine: OCI
references (the bundle and any registry-sourced parser modules) and, unless
--oci-only is passed, the hash-pinned https downloads.

It answers "what do I have to mirror?" without touching the network, so it runs
inside a firewall. Output is deterministic and sorted, which makes it usable as
input to a mirroring loop:

  datamitsu store refs --oci-only | xargs -n1 -I{} crane copy {} harbor.corp/dm/{}

Runtime archives (node, uv, the JDK) are resolved from a generated manifest at
install time rather than declared in the config, so they are not listed here.

Usage:
  datamitsu store refs [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help       help for refs
      --json       Emit the references as JSON, including each artifact's mandatory hash
      --oci-only   List only OCI references, omitting the hash-pinned https downloads

Global Flags:
      --before-config strings   Configuration file(s) to load before auto-discovery (for wrappers/libraries)
      --binary-command string   Override the binary command (for npm package wrappers, etc). Can also be set via DATAMITSU_BINARY_COMMAND env var
      --config strings          Additional configuration file(s) to load and merge (can be specified multiple times)
      --log-format string       Status output format: console or jsonl (also via DATAMITSU_LOG_FORMAT)
      --no-auto-config          Disable auto-discovery of datamitsu.config.{js,mjs,ts} at git root
      --no-oci                  Disable OCI bundle store seeding (also via DATAMITSU_NO_OCI)
      --no-parse                Skip output parsers; show tools' raw output instead (also via DATAMITSU_NO_PARSE)
  -v, --verbose                 Enable debug-level logging (default level is warn)
